Title: Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP)
Summary: This RFC defines the Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP), a supplementary protocol to IP that reports errors in IP datagram processing and provides other control messages.

Sections.Title: Introduction
Sections.Content: ICMP is a supplementary protocol to IP that reports errors in IP datagram processing and provides other control messages.

Sections.Title: Message Format and Codes
Sections.Content: ICMP messages are carried as Internet Data Grams (IP packets) with Type-of-Service set to 0, and the first byte of the ICMP header set to 0 (to prevent fragmentation). Each ICMP message has a type and code. The type indicates the kind of message, and the code provides further detail about the message.

Sections.Title: Echo Request and Echo Reply
Sections.Content: Echo request and reply messages are used to measure round-trip delay. The data field in the echo request is echoed back in the reply.

Sections.Title: Destination Unreachable
Sections.Content: Sent when a packet cannot be delivered to its intended recipient, indicating the reason such as net unreachable, host unreachable, port unreachable, etc.

Sections.Title: Source Quench
Sections.Content: Sent when a gateway or host is experiencing congestion, requesting the sender to reduce the rate of datagram traffic.

Sections.Title: Redirect
Sections.Content: Suggests an alternative route for the current datagram and future datagrams from the source host.

Sections.Title: Alternate Host Address
Sections.Content: Carried in an IP datagram when the destination host has multiple network interfaces and the sender wishes to direct the datagram to one of them.

Sections.Title: Time Exceeded
Sections.Content: Indicates that the Time-to-Live field in the IP header has reached zero, thus the datagram must be discarded.

Sections.Title: Parameter Problem
Sections.Content: Indicates a problem with some parameter in the IP header.

Sections.Title: Timestamp
Sections.Content: Provides timestamp information for network measurement.

Sections.Title: Information Request
Sections.Content: Requests network configuration information from a host.
